name: A credit note reduces the amount and its late fee in proportion
title: SC-07-11-03 A credit note reduces the amount and its late fee in proportion
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given unit "A-14" owes 1400.00 due on "2026-10-15" with a late fee of 23.33
When a credit note of 700.00 with reason "budget revision" is approved
Then the liability amount is 700.00
And the late fee is 11.67
